Card Q&A.a: No. This card's effect can only be used on Digimon cards that are digivolution cards. It can't be used on Digi-Egg cards or Tamer cards in a Digimon's digivolution cards.
Card Q&A.q: Can I use the effect of this Option card to play a level 2 Digimon that is currently a digivolution card of one of my Digimon?

Card Q&A.a: No. Since it is played as another Digimon, it is played unsuspended.
Card Q&A.q: If I use this Option card's effect to play a digivolution card of one of my suspended Digimon, does it come into play suspended?

Card Q&A.a: No. Since it is played as another Digimon, it is not affected by any effects of the original Digimon it was under.
Card Q&A.q: If one of my Digimon has an effect applied to it that lasts a turn, then I use the effect of this Option card to play one of its digivolution cards as a Digimon, does that Digimon come into play with the same effect applied to it?

Card Q&A.a: No, since it would count as the turn they were played.
Card Q&A.q: Can Digimon played by this card's effect attack the turn they were played?

Effect: [Main] Choose a Digimon digivolution card placed under 1 of your Digimon and play it as another Digimon without paying its memory cost.
